thought.text: The WMS is fully operational with its layer tree. Let me run comprehensive verification of all documented endpoints:

reasoning_content:
XPlanWMS is currently running with its complete layer tree. Next, I'll verify all endpoints through the proxy (the documented public URLs in the XPlanRessourcen section) and check the status of all other components:

1. All 8 documented GetCapabilities URLs
2. Manager web, validator web
3. REST APIs (manager-api, validator-api, dokumente-api)
4. Validator WMS
5. MapServer directly

After that, I'll do the final wrap-up:
- Start XPlanValidatorExecutor (standalone java app)
- Test XPlanCLI
- Verify that the documentation zip has been extracted

Also, I should update the URLs in index.html of xplan-webpages (per the guide it's optional — the "müssen ggf. angepasst werden (need to be adapted as necessary)" part) — the URLs in the guide's list point to localhost:8080, which is now working via the proxy.

action.command:
echo "=== Documented XPlanRessourcen GetCapabilities URLs (guide section XPlanRessourcen) ==="
while read -r url; do
  code=$(timeout 40 curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "$url")
  bytes=$(timeout 40 curl -s "$url" | wc -c)
  echo "HTTP $code ($bytes bytes): $url"
done <<'URLS'
http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wms/services/wms?service=WMS&request=GetCapabilities
http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs-syn/services/xplansynwfs?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities
http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs40?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities
http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs41?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities
http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs50?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities
http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs51?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities
http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs52?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities
http://localhost:8080/xplan-services-wfs/services/wfs60?service=WFS&request=GetCapabilities
URLS
